subject: Choosing SCC modules — phased rollout, audit trail & DocuSign

Cc: legal-ops@brightharborhealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:07:00 +0000
Subject: SCC modules for BrightHarbor — required confirmations and evidence request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the product demo last week. Our legal and privacy teams are working through the DPA and need two quick confirmations from Redwood before we proceed to DocuSign:

1) Which SCC module(s) will Redwood expect BrightHarbor to execute with you for EU and UK personal data transfers (we are a data controller; Redwood will act as processor)?
2) Will Redwood sign the UK Addendum to the EU SCCs or provide a separate UK SCC execution path?
3) Please share the DPIA (or the DPIA template filled with the minimal details we requested), SOC 2 Type II report reference, and any standard subprocessors list and audit-rights description.

We need this info for our internal privacy board meeting on Monday. If possible, share an execution timeline and any DocuSign link so we can loop in Procurement.

Best,
Anna Laurent
DPO, BrightHarbor Health
anna.laurent@brightharborhealth.com

Attachments: none
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 13:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SCC modules for BrightHarbor — required confirmations and evidence request

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. Summary answers up front, details below.

Short answers:
- Preferred module: Controller-to-Processor (Module Two) for both EU and UK transfers, executed with the EU SCCs + Redwood's UK Addendum attachment (we attach the UK addendum as part of our DPA packet).
- If your legal team prefers a C2C approach for any specific data flow, we can evaluate, but our standard is Module Two (C2P).
- Attached: SCCs-module-options-v2.pdf (matrix of options), DPIA-template-filled.xlsx (redacted example), and an SCCs executive summary. We will also provide SOC 2 Type II report reference and auditor contact in a secure link.

Implementation notes (technical/legal):
- Role alignment: BrightHarbor (controller) -> Redwood (processor). Module Two maps to that relationship and aligns with our subprocessors policy.
- UK coverage: we append the Redwood UK Addendum (signed with the DPA). This provides a single-path execution — EU SCCs (Module Two) + UK Addendum.
- Subprocessors & audits: We maintain an up-to-date subprocessors list on our privacy portal and offer: quarterly subprocessors snapshots, 30 days' notice for new subprocessors, and audit rights via a standard third-party auditor process (per the DPA section 7).
- Retention & deletion: We include a DPA Annex (data flow + retention table) that BrightHarbor can use to specify retention periods per dataset.

Proposed timeline (we can accelerate if you need):
- Thu 19 Nov: Share materials (attached) + DocuSign envelope created.
- Fri 20 Nov: BrightHarbor legal review; confirm module selection.
- Mon 23 Nov: Procurement signs DPA in DocuSign — receive executed copy.
- Tue 24 Nov: Redwood provisioning and onboarding (pilot region EU-west).

Next steps ask: if you can confirm Module Two + UK Addendum by EOD Fri we will send the DocuSign envelope and the secure SOC 2 report link.

Thanks — copying our security/legal leads for transparency.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance (Sales Engineering liaison)
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SCC modules for BrightHarbor — quick technical/controls notes

Quick internal notes for the record (cc Naomi):
- Confirm brightharbor's primary datasets: PHI-adjacent telemetry + customer-supplied PII. Need the DPIA details granularly filled (the template we attached is intentionally light — ask them to populate columns marked "required for DPIA" with data categories and retention).
- Key controls to highlight in our replies: HSM-managed KMS for customer keys (optional), signed subprocessors list exportable as CSV, retention & deletion SLAs, and a 3rd-party attestation process for audits (we don't permit full on-site audits but will provide SOC 2 + auditor confirmation and a limited-scope questionnaire response).
- For the UK Addendum we should confirm jurisdiction clause and contact for legal notices (suggest: laura.bennett@redwoodai.com).

I'll prepare a short Q&A annex so Procurement doesn't get stuck on audit semantics.

—Rishi
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

1) Module Two (C2P) + UK Addendum is acceptable in principle. We need the subprocessors CSV and the exportable audit-rights text (short paragraph we can paste into our DPA) before procurement signs.
2) Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a one-off data-processing exhibit listing our retention periods (yes/no)? We prefer a single signed DPA + annex rather than multiple amendments.
3) Final ask: please share the DocuSign envelope link so Procurement can review the exact language in the DPA/DPA Annex.

If you can provide items above by 14:00 UTC today, we will escalate to Procurement and try to sign on Monday.

Thanks,
Anna

3) DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/some-ds-link/BRIGHT-1234 (preview-only link for legal review).

- Contact for UK Addendum notices: laura.bennett@redwoodai.com.
